chapter.heading: Psalm 129
They Have Afflicted Me from My Youth
A Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
“Greatly(1) have
they afflicted,
me from my youth”— let Israel now say—

“Greatly have
they afflicted,
me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me.

The plowers
plowed upon,
my back; they made long their furrows.”

The LORD
is righteous;,
he has cut the cords of the wicked.

May all
who hate,
Zion be put to shame and turned backward!

Let them
be like,
the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,

with which
the reaper,
does not fill his hand nor the binder of sheaves his arms,

nor do
those who,
pass by say, “The blessing of the LORD be upon you! We bless you in the name of the LORD!” Footnotes (1) 129:1 Or *Often*; also verse 2 (ESV)
